name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the summary captures the main ideas and essential information from the original document.

name: Conciseness
description: Evaluates whether the summary is succinct and free of unnecessary details while still covering the critical points.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the summary, ensuring that the information is presented in a well-organized manner.

name: Accuracy
description: Determines if the summary accurately reflects the information in the original document without introducing errors or misinterpretations.

name: Coverage
description: Checks if the summary includes all significant aspects and sections of the original text, providing a comprehensive overview.
